the implementation of sustainable supply chain management initiatives requires the alignment of corporate sustainability approaches and governance at the supply chain.

In summary, our research is concerned with
sustainability in supply chain management and, more in detail, with the role of governance mechanisms in implementing sustainability initiatives in supply chains.
the alignment of governance mechanisms with corporate sustainability approaches, with the aim to identify the factors that enable governance in sustainable supply chain contexts.
sustainability approaches and governance at the supply chain management level.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
governance mechanisms are the key to sustainability success, and that sustainability initiatives are the drivers of governance.
the sustainability profile of the focal organisation and the level of formalisation and collaboration are the two main drivers for governance mechanisms.
sustainability leaders are able to align governance mechanisms with sustainability approaches and that this alignment is facilitated by the presence of certain organisational factors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
governance mechanisms are not a one size fits all solution, and that a more tailored approach is needed.
the sustainability profile and the type of governance mechanism are two factors that influence each other and should be aligned in order to achieve sustainability goals.

governance mechanisms can be classified on the basis of the level of collaboration and formality, and that they are enabled by the existence of a corporate sustainability approach, the presence of a sustainability champion, and the alignment between the governance mechanism and the corporate sustainability approach.
The main takeaway from our work is that
sustainability initiatives are not a “one size fits all” approach and should be tailored to the context in which they operate.
the alignment between sustainability and governance mechanisms is a critical factor to ensure the success of supply chains sustainability initiatives.
the sustainability approach of a focal firm and its governance mechanism should be aligned with the sustainability approach of the other firms in the supply chain.
